The Moon is daydreaming in Pisces. Join her.

The Moon spends the whole day in Pisces and trines Mercury in Scorpio late tonight. Swipe for Taurus, Virgo and Capricorn, plus one question to journal on today.

Save this for tonight, or send it to your Earth friend. 🌙

slides.body: The Moon swims through your house of words and short trips. Late tonight she trines Mercury: send the note or the voice memo.
